It is often said that Umamusume who 
perform well in the Shion Stakes tend to 
succeed in the Shuka Sho as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having grown stronger through summer 
training camp, Vivlos heads into the Shion 
Stakes to test her current abilities for 
the final crown of the Triple Tiara!
